description: Connects a domain to a website built and hosted on InstaBuild. Adds an ownership TXT record and points www at InstaBuild. The bare domain is left alone, because many DNS providers cannot point it at a hostname; InstaBuild asks the owner to forward it to www. Mail and other records are not touched. For Cloudflare DNS, InstaBuild uses the website-cloudflare template instead.
variableDescription: %verify%: the 32 character hex ownership code InstaBuild shows the owner for this domain
